shared_elements: carved relief on an upright stone slab/pillar
register-like horizontal division of the surface
small repeated incised signs arranged in rows
justification: A depicts a rich figural program — a row of quadrupeds along the top, a snarling carnivore in profile above a small crouching human-like figure, a bird/waterfowl and other creatures in stacked registers — whereas B shows only faint horizontal lines of small repeated incised marks with no discernible animal or human figures. The only real correspondence is the generic one of low relief on an upright slab organised in horizontal bands, which any carving tradition could produce independently.
